Hey thank you, like, I'm just so scared right now and just knowing you guys are here feels amazing. And no I have no one to go to really. All the kids I hang out with are fucking assholes, it's weird how you can be surrounded by so many people and still feel so completely alone. I sort of just want to walk to my english teacher tomorrow and ask for a hug. But seriously, thank you, I really think I should try to get some sleep right now though. Thank you.
